title: Pre-game declaration artifact
description: Every `required` entry below is mandated by the BOOK, not inferred from a template. `U-019` records that the example artifacts prove only that keys occur in the inspected bytes -- they establish no requiredness -- and `X-04` is what happens when a schema asserts more than the sources support: it validated a template and refused every real artifact. additionalProperties is TRUE because the book was asked directly and is NOT-SPECIFIED on whether extra non-contradicting fields are forbidden in the reporting artifacts. Refusing an opponent's declaration over a key no source forbids would fail rule 36's mutual audit for no reason.

groups.description: Both groups. Rule 49 wants four repository links across the pair, and p.78/183 wants the MCP addresses.

mcp_servers.description: Public addresses only. A URL carrying a credential breaches rule 39, which forbids secrets in the repository even when it is private.

llm_model.description: Rule 24, p.39/104. Sanction: denial of eligibility for computational bonuses.

hardware_spec.description: p.39/104 and inst/:1278 list Operating System first, then CPU cores and frequency, RAM, and GPU/VRAM presence. `os` is required here because the book requires it -- it was absent from both repositories until 2026-08-07.

github_commit.description: Rule 53, p.40/106: the exact commit of the code that plays. Hex-only, seven to forty characters. minLength alone was not enough -- the reference hard-codes the string 'unknown', which is exactly seven characters and passed a length check while identifying nothing.

games_played_declaration.description: Rule 37, p.131/275: an accurate count of games actually played, declared at the start of each game. Rule 38 makes a false declaration absolute disqualification of the project, which is why the count is derived from emitted result artifacts rather than entered by hand.
